class TestBaseUnorderedSequenceSerializer(SimpleTestCase):
    def test_base_unordered_sequence_serializer_sorts_by_repr(self):
        from django.db.migrations.serializer import BaseUnorderedSequenceSerializer
        
        class CustomClass:
            def __init__(self, val):
                self.val = val
            def __repr__(self):
                return f"CustomClass({self.val})"
        
        items = [CustomClass(3), CustomClass(1), CustomClass(2)]
        # This will fail because _format is not implemented, but init should work
        try:
            serializer = BaseUnorderedSequenceSerializer(items)
            # Check that value was sorted
            self.assertEqual(len(serializer.value), 3)
        except NotImplementedError:
            pass  # Expected since _format is not implemented

class QueryUtilsTests(SimpleTestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        from django.db.models.query_utils import PathInfo

        from django.db.models.query_utils import PathInfo
        path_info = PathInfo(
            from_opts=None,
            to_opts=None,
            target_fields=[],
            join_field=None,
            m2m=False,
            direct=True,
            filtered_relation=None
        )
        self.assertIsNotNone(path_info)
        self.assertEqual(path_info.from_opts, None)
        self.assertEqual(path_info.direct, True)

    def test_pathinfo_unpacking(self):
        """Test PathInfo unpacking."""

        path_info = PathInfo(None, None, [], None, False, True, None)

class QTests(SimpleTestCase):
    """Test Q class functionality."""

    def test_q_init_empty(self):
        """Test Q initialization with no arguments."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q = Q()
        self.assertEqual(q.connector, Q.AND)
        self.assertFalse(q.negated)
        self.assertEqual(len(q.children), 0)

    def test_q_init_with_kwargs(self):
        """Test Q initialization with keyword arguments."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q = Q(name='test')
        self.assertEqual(len(q.children), 1)
        self.assertIn(('name', 'test'), q.children)

    def test_q_init_with_args(self):
        """Test Q initialization with positional arguments."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q1 = Q(name='test')
        q2 = Q(age=25)
        q = Q(q1, q2)
        self.assertEqual(len(q.children), 2)

    def test_q_init_with_connector(self):
        """Test Q initialization with custom connector."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q = Q(name='test', _connector=Q.OR)
        self.assertEqual(q.connector, Q.OR)

    def test_q_init_with_negated(self):
        """Test Q initialization with negated flag."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q = Q(name='test', _negated=True)
        self.assertTrue(q.negated)

    def test_q_or_operator(self):
        """Test Q OR operator."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q1 = Q(name='test')
        q2 = Q(age=25)
        q = q1 | q2
        self.assertEqual(q.connector, Q.OR)

    def test_q_and_operator(self):
        """Test Q AND operator."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q1 = Q(name='test')
        q2 = Q(age=25)
        q = q1 & q2
        self.assertEqual(q.connector, Q.AND)

    def test_q_invert_operator(self):
        """Test Q invert operator."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q = ~Q(name='test')
        self.assertTrue(q.negated)

    def test_q_combine_with_empty_other(self):
        """Test Q._combine when other is empty."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q1 = Q(name='test')
        q2 = Q()
        result = q1._combine(q2, Q.AND)
        self.assertEqual(result.children, q1.children)

    def test_q_combine_with_empty_self(self):
        """Test Q._combine when self is empty."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q1 = Q()
        q2 = Q(name='test')
        result = q1._combine(q2, Q.AND)
        self.assertEqual(result.children, q2.children)

    def test_q_combine_raises_typeerror(self):
        """Test Q._combine raises TypeError for non-Q objects."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q = Q(name='test')
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            q._combine('not a q object', Q.AND)

    def test_q_deconstruct_single_child(self):
        """Test Q.deconstruct with single child."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q = Q(name='test')
        path, args, kwargs = q.deconstruct()
        self.assertIn('django.db.models', path)
        self.assertEqual(kwargs.get('name'), 'test')

    def test_q_deconstruct_multiple_children(self):
        """Test Q.deconstruct with multiple children."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q1 = Q(name='test')
        q2 = Q(age=25)
        q = q1 & q2
        path, args, kwargs = q.deconstruct()
        self.assertEqual(len(args), 2)

    def test_q_deconstruct_custom_connector(self):
        """Test Q.deconstruct with custom connector."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q1 = Q(name='test')
        q2 = Q(age=25)
        q = q1 | q2  # OR connector
        path, args, kwargs = q.deconstruct()
        self.assertEqual(kwargs.get('_connector'), Q.OR)

    def test_q_deconstruct_negated(self):
        """Test Q.deconstruct with negated flag."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        q = Q(name='test', _negated=True)
        path, args, kwargs = q.deconstruct()
        self.assertTrue(kwargs.get('_negated'))

    def test_registerlookupmixin_merge_dicts_reverse_order(self):
        """Test merge_dicts with reversed order."""

        dict_a = {'key_a': 'value_a'}
        dict_b = {'key_b': 'value_b'}
        
        result = RegisterLookupMixin.merge_dicts([dict_a, dict_b])
        self.assertEqual(result['key_a'], 'value_a')

        self.assertEqual(result, mock_lookup)
        self.assertIn('test_lookup', TestMixin.class_lookups)

    def test_registerlookupmixin_unregister_lookup(self):
        """Test _unregister_lookup removes lookup."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import RegisterLookupMixin
        
        class TestMixin(RegisterLookupMixin):
            pass
        
        class MockLookup:
            lookup_name = 'test_lookup'

        self.assertIn('test_lookup', TestMixin.class_lookups)

class FilteredRelationTests(SimpleTestCase):
    """Test FilteredRelation class."""

    def test_filteredrelation_init_valid(self):
        """Test FilteredRelation initialization with valid arguments."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import FilteredRelation
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        
        fr = FilteredRelation('test_relation')
        self.assertEqual(fr.relation_name, 'test_relation')
        self.assertIsNone(fr.alias)
        self.assertEqual(fr.path, [])

    def test_filteredrelation_init_empty_relation_name_raises(self):
        """Test FilteredRelation raises ValueError for empty relation_name."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import FilteredRelation
        
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            FilteredRelation('')

    def test_filteredrelation_init_invalid_condition_raises(self):
        """Test FilteredRelation raises ValueError for invalid condition."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import FilteredRelation
        
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            FilteredRelation('test', condition='not a Q object')

    def test_filteredrelation_eq_true(self):
        """Test FilteredRelation.__eq__ returns True for equal objects."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import FilteredRelation
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        
        fr1 = FilteredRelation('test', condition=Q(name='test'))
        fr2 = FilteredRelation('test', condition=Q(name='test'))
        
        self.assertEqual(fr1, fr2)

    def test_filteredrelation_eq_false_different_relation_name(self):
        """Test FilteredRelation.__eq__ returns False for different relation names."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import FilteredRelation
        
        fr1 = FilteredRelation('relation1')
        fr2 = FilteredRelation('relation2')
        
        self.assertNotEqual(fr1, fr2)

    def test_filteredrelation_eq_false_different_alias(self):
        """Test FilteredRelation.__eq__ returns False for different aliases."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import FilteredRelation
        
        fr1 = FilteredRelation('test')
        fr1.alias = 'alias1'
        fr2 = FilteredRelation('test')
        fr2.alias = 'alias2'
        
        self.assertNotEqual(fr1, fr2)

    def test_filteredrelation_eq_different_class(self):
        """Test FilteredRelation.__eq__ returns NotImplemented for different class."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import FilteredRelation
        
        fr = FilteredRelation('test')
        result = fr.__eq__('not a FilteredRelation')
        self.assertIs(result, NotImplemented)

    def test_filteredrelation_clone(self):
        """Test FilteredRelation.clone creates a copy."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import FilteredRelation
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        
        fr1 = FilteredRelation('test', condition=Q(name='test'))
        fr1.alias = 'my_alias'
        fr1.path = ['path1', 'path2']
        
        fr2 = fr1.clone()
        
        self.assertEqual(fr2.relation_name, fr1.relation_name)
        self.assertEqual(fr2.alias, fr1.alias)
        self.assertEqual(fr2.path, fr1.path[:])
        self.assertIsNot(fr2.path, fr1.path)

        """Test FilteredRelation.resolve_expression raises NotImplementedError."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import FilteredRelation
        
        fr = FilteredRelation('test')
        with self.assertRaises(NotImplementedError):
            fr.resolve_expression()

        """Test FilteredRelation.as_sql compiles the where clause."""
        from django.db.models.query_utils import FilteredRelation
        from django.db.models.query_utils import Q
        
        fr = FilteredRelation('test', condition=Q(name='test'))
        
        # as_sql requires compiler and connection which we don't have in unit tests
        # Just verify the method exists and doesn't crash on basic setup
        self.assertTrue(hasattr(fr, 'as_sql'))

"""Tests for the LaTeX printer."""

from sympy.printing.latex import latex, LatexPrinter, translate


class TestLatexBasic:
    """Test basic LaTeX printing functionality."""

    def test_print_integer(self):
        from sympy import Integer
        local_test = Integer(5)
        result = latex(local_test)
        assert result == "5"

    def test_print_float(self):
        from sympy import Float
        local_test = Float(3.14)
        result = latex(local_test)
        assert "3.14" in result

    def test_print_rational(self):
        from sympy import Rational
        local_test = Rational(3, 4)
        result = latex(local_test)
        assert "\\frac{3}{4}" in result or "3 / 4" in result

    def test_print_symbol(self):
        from sympy import Symbol
        x = Symbol('x')
        result = latex(x)
        assert result == "x"

    def test_print_pi(self):
        from sympy import pi
        result = latex(pi)
        assert result == "\\pi"

    def test_print_e(self):
        from sympy import E
        result = latex(E)
        assert result == "e"


class TestLatexAdd:
    """Test addition expressions."""

    def test_add_simple(self):
        from sympy import Symbol
        x, y = Symbol('x'), Symbol('y')
        result = latex(x + y)
        assert "+" in result

    def test_add_three_terms(self):
        from sympy import Symbol
        x, y, z = Symbol('x'), Symbol('y'), Symbol('z')
        result = latex(x + y + z)
        assert "+" in result

    def test_add_with_negative(self):
        from sympy import Symbol
        x, y = Symbol('x'), Symbol('y')
        result = latex(x - y)
        assert "-" in result


class TestLatexMul:
    """Test multiplication expressions."""

    def test_mul_simple(self):
        from sympy import Symbol
        x, y = Symbol('x'), Symbol('y')
        result = latex(x * y)
        assert "x" in result and "y" in result

    def test_mul_number_variable(self):
        from sympy import Symbol
        x = Symbol('x')
        result = latex(2 * x)
        assert "2" in result and "x" in result


class TestLatexPow:

        from sympy import Symbol, Rational

        assert "\\sqrt{" in result

        result = latex(x ** Rational(1, 3))

class TestLatexObjectMorphismCategory:
    """Test category theory objects."""

    def test_object(self):
        from sympy.categories import Object
        O = Object("O")
        result = latex(O)
        assert "O" in result

    def test_morphism(self):
        from sympy.categories import Morphism, Object
        O1 = Object("O1")
        O2 = Object("O2")
        f = Morphism(O1, O2)
        result = latex(f)
        assert "\\rightarrow" in result

    def test_identitymorphism(self):
        from sympy.categories import IdentityMorphism, Object
        O = Object("O")
        f = IdentityMorphism(O)
        result = latex(f)
        assert "id" in result

    def test_compositemorphism(self):
        from sympy.categories import CompositeMorphism, Object, Morphism
        O1 = Object("O1")
        O2 = Object("O2")
        O3 = Object("O3")
        f = Morphism(O1, O2)
        g = Morphism(O2, O3)
        h = CompositeMorphism(f, g)
        result = latex(h)

"""Tests for sklearn.preprocessing.label module."""

import numpy as np
import pytest
import array
import scipy.sparse as sp

from sklearn.preprocessing.label import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.preprocessing.label import LabelBinarizer
from sklearn.preprocessing.label import MultiLabelBinarizer
from sklearn.preprocessing.label import label_binarize


class TestLabelEncoder:
    """Test cases for LabelEncoder class."""

    def test_fit(self):
        """Test fit method of LabelEncoder."""
        le = LabelEncoder()
        result = le.fit([1, 2, 2, 6])
        assert result is le
        assert np.array_equal(le.classes_, np.array([1, 2, 6]))

    def test_fit_transform(self):
        """Test fit_transform method of LabelEncoder."""
        le = LabelEncoder()
        result = le.fit_transform([1, 2, 2, 6])
        assert np.array_equal(result, np.array([0, 1, 1, 2]))

    def test_transform(self):
        """Test transform method of LabelEncoder."""
        le = LabelEncoder()
        le.fit([1, 2, 2, 6])
        result = le.transform([1, 1, 2, 6])
        assert np.array_equal(result, np.array([0, 0, 1, 2]))

    def test_inverse_transform(self):
        """Test inverse_transform method of LabelEncoder."""
        le = LabelEncoder()
        le.fit([1, 2, 2, 6])
        result = le.inverse_transform([0, 0, 1, 2])
        assert np.array_equal(result, np.array([1, 1, 2, 6]))

    def test_transform_unseen_labels(self):
        """Test transform raises error for unseen labels."""
        le = LabelEncoder()
        le.fit([1, 2, 2, 6])
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            le.transform([1, 2, 3])

    def test_inverse_transform_unseen_labels(self):
        """Test inverse_transform raises error for unseen labels."""
        le = LabelEncoder()
        le.fit([1, 2, 2, 6])
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            le.inverse_transform([0, 0, 5])

    def test_empty_array_transform(self):
        """Test transform with empty array."""
        le = LabelEncoder()
        le.fit([1, 2, 2, 6])
        result = le.transform([])
        assert len(result) == 0

    def test_empty_array_inverse_transform(self):
        """Test inverse_transform with empty array."""
        le = LabelEncoder()
        le.fit([1, 2, 2, 6])
        result = le.inverse_transform([])
        assert len(result) == 0

    def test_string_labels(self):
        """Test with string labels."""
        le = LabelEncoder()
        le.fit(["paris", "paris", "tokyo", "amsterdam"])
        assert np.array_equal(le.classes_, np.array(['amsterdam', 'paris', 'tokyo']))
        result = le.transform(["tokyo", "tokyo", "paris"])

    """Test check_errors decorator."""
    
    def setUp(self):
        from django.utils import autoreload
        self.autoreload = autoreload
    
    def tearDown(self):
        # Reset global state
        self.autoreload._error_files.clear()
        self.autoreload._exception = None
    
    def test_check_errors_success(self):
        """Test check_errors with successful function."""

            called.append(True)
            return "success"

        self.assertTrue(called)
    
    def test_check_errors_raises_exception(self):

            raise ValueError("test error")
        
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
            fail_func()

    def test_check_errors_captures_exception(self):

        @self.autoreload.check_errors

            raise RuntimeError("captured error")
        
        try:
            fail_func()
        except RuntimeError:
            pass
        
        # The exception should be captured
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.autoreload._exception)
    
    def test_check_errors_adds_to_error_files(self):

"""

from unittest import mock

from django.core.exceptions import FieldError, ImproperlyConfigured, ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.forms import Form, ModelMultipleChoiceField, RadioSelect, SelectMultiple
from django.forms.models import (
    ALL_FIELDS, BaseModelForm, BaseModelFormSet, BaseInlineFormSet,
    ModelChoiceField, ModelChoiceIterator, ModelChoiceIteratorValue,
    ModelForm, ModelFormMetaclass, ModelMultipleChoiceField as MCMF, construct_instance,
    fields_for_model, modelform_factory, modelformset_factory,
)
from django.test import SimpleTestCase

from .models import Category, Writer


class TestModelChoiceIteratorValue(SimpleTestCase):
    """Tests for ModelChoiceIteratorValue class."""

    def test_init(self):
        value = 1
        instance = mock.MagicMock()
        obj = ModelChoiceIteratorValue(value, instance)
        self.assertEqual(obj.value, value)
        self.assertEqual(obj.instance, instance)

    def test_str(self):
        value = "test_value"
        instance = mock.MagicMock()
        obj = ModelChoiceIteratorValue(value, instance)
        self.assertEqual(str(obj), "test_value")

    def test_hash(self):
        value = 123
        instance = mock.MagicMock()
        obj = ModelChoiceIteratorValue(value, instance)
        self.assertEqual(hash(obj), hash(value))

    def test_eq_with_same_value(self):
        value = 456
        instance1 = mock.MagicMock()
        instance2 = mock.MagicMock()
        obj1 = ModelChoiceIteratorValue(value, instance1)
        obj2 = ModelChoiceIteratorValue(value, instance2)
        self.assertEqual(obj1, obj2)

    def test_eq_with_different_value(self):
        value1 = 789
        value2 = 999
        instance = mock.MagicMock()
        obj1 = ModelChoiceIteratorValue(value1, instance)
        obj2 = ModelChoiceIteratorValue(value2, instance)
        self.assertNotEqual(obj1, obj2)

    def test_eq_with_plain_value(self):
        value = 111
        instance = mock.MagicMock()
        obj = ModelChoiceIteratorValue(value, instance)
        self.assertEqual(obj, value)


class TestModelChoiceIterator(SimpleTestCase):
    """Tests for ModelChoiceIterator class."""

    def test_init(self):
        field = mock.MagicMock()
        iterator = ModelChoiceIterator(field)
        self.assertIs(iterator.field, field)

    def test_iter_with_empty_label(self):
        field = mock.MagicMock()
        field.empty_label = "---------"
        field.queryset.model = mock.MagicMock()
        field.queryset._prefetch_related_lookups = {}
        field.label_from_instance.return_value = "Label"
        
        mock_obj = mock.MagicMock()
        mock_obj.pk = 1
        
        field.queryset.iterator.return_value = [mock_obj]
        
        iterator = ModelChoiceIterator(field)
        choices = list(iterator)
        
        self.assertEqual(len(choices), 2)
        self.assertEqual(choices[0][0], "")
        self.assertEqual(choices[0][1], "---------")

    def test_iter_without_empty_label(self):
        field = mock.MagicMock()
        field.empty_label = None
        field.queryset.model = mock.MagicMock()
        field.queryset._prefetch_related_lookups = {}
        field.label_from_instance.return_value = "Label"
        
        mock_obj = mock.MagicMock()
        mock_obj.pk = 1
        
        field.queryset.iterator.return_value = [mock_obj]
        
        iterator = ModelChoiceIterator(field)
        choices = list(iterator)
        
        self.assertEqual(len(choices), 1)

    def test_len_with_empty_label(self):
        field = mock.MagicMock()
        field.empty_label = "---------"
        field.queryset.count.return_value = 5
        
        iterator = ModelChoiceIterator(field)
        self.assertEqual(len(iterator), 6)

    def test_len_without_empty_label(self):
        field = mock.MagicMock()
        field.empty_label = None
        field.queryset.count.return_value = 5
        
        iterator = ModelChoiceIterator(field)
        self.assertEqual(len(iterator), 5)

    def test_bool_with_empty_label(self):
        field = mock.MagicMock()
        field.empty_label = "---------"
        
        iterator = ModelChoiceIterator(field)
        self.assertTrue(bool(iterator))

    def test_bool_without_empty_label_but_exists(self):
        field = mock.MagicMock()
        field.empty_label = None
        field.queryset.exists.return_value = True
        
        iterator = ModelChoiceIterator(field)
        self.assertTrue(bool(iterator))

    def test_bool_false_when_nothing(self):
        field = mock.MagicMock()
        field.empty_label = None

        iterator = ModelChoiceIterator(field)
        self.assertFalse(bool(iterator))


class TestModelChoiceField(SimpleTestCase):
    """Tests for ModelChoiceField class."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.mock_queryset = mock.MagicMock()
        self.mock_queryset.model = mock.MagicMock()
        self.mock_qs_does_not_exist = type('DoesNotExist', (Exception,), {})
        self.mock_queryset.model.DoesNotExist = self.mock_qs_does_not_exist
        self.mock_queryset.get.return_value = mock.MagicMock()
        self.mock_queryset.all.return_value = self.mock_queryset

    def test_init_required_true(self):
        field = ModelChoiceField(queryset=self.mock_queryset, required=True)
        self.assertTrue(field.required)
        self.assertIsNone(field.empty_label)

    def test_init_required_false(self):
        field = ModelChoiceField(queryset=self.mock_queryset, required=False)
        self.assertFalse(field.required)
        self.assertEqual(field.empty_label, "---------")

    def test_init_blank_true_with_radio_select(self):
        widget = RadioSelect()
        field = ModelChoiceField(
            queryset=self.mock_queryset, 
            required=False, 
            widget=widget, 
            blank=True
        )
        self.assertEqual(field.empty_label, "---------")

    def test_init_blank_false_with_radio_select(self):
        widget = RadioSelect()
        field = ModelChoiceField(
            queryset=self.mock_queryset, 
            required=False, 
            widget=widget, 
            blank=False
        )
        self.assertIsNone(field.empty_label)

    def test_get_limit_choices_to_callable(self):
        callable_func = mock.MagicMock(return_value={'active': True})
        field = ModelChoiceField(
            queryset=self.mock_queryset, 
            limit_choices_to=callable_func
        )
        result = field.get_limit_choices_to()
        self.assertEqual(result, {'active': True})

    def test_get_limit_choices_to_not_callable(self):
        field = ModelChoiceField(
            queryset=self.mock_queryset, 
            limit_choices_to={'active': True}
        )
        result = field.get_limit_choices_to()
        self.assertEqual(result, {'active': True})

    def test_deepcopy(self):
        import copy
        field = ModelChoiceField(queryset=self.mock_queryset)
        new_field = copy.deepcopy(field)
        self.assertIsNot(new_field, field)
        self.assertIsNot(new_field.queryset, field.queryset)

    def test_set_queryset_none(self):
        field = ModelChoiceField(queryset=self.mock_queryset)
        field.queryset = None
        self.assertIsNone(field.queryset)

    def test_set_queryset_valid(self):
        new_qs = mock.MagicMock()
        new_qs.all.return_value = new_qs
        field = ModelChoiceField(queryset=self.mock_queryset)
        field.queryset = new_qs
        self.assertIsNot(field.queryset, new_qs)

    def test_label_from_instance(self):
        field = ModelChoiceField(queryset=self.mock_queryset)
        mock_obj = mock.MagicMock()
        mock_obj.__str__ = mock.MagicMock(return_value="Test Object")
        label = field.label_from_instance(mock_obj)
        self.assertEqual(label, "Test Object")

    def test_prepare_value_with_model_instance(self):
        field = ModelChoiceField(queryset=self.mock_queryset)
        mock_obj = mock.MagicMock()
        mock_obj.pk = 123
        mock_obj._meta = mock.MagicMock()
        value = field.prepare_value(mock_obj)
        self.assertEqual(value, 123)

    def test_prepare_value_with_to_field_name(self):
        field = ModelChoiceField(
            queryset=self.mock_queryset, 
            to_field_name='custom_id'
        )
        mock_obj = mock.MagicMock()
        mock_obj.serializable_value.return_value = 'custom_123'
        value = field.prepare_value(mock_obj)
        self.assertEqual(value, 'custom_123')

    def test_prepare_value_non_model(self):
        field = ModelChoiceField(queryset=self.mock_queryset)
        value = field.prepare_value('plain_value')
        self.assertEqual(value, 'plain_value')

    def test_to_python_valid_pk(self):
        mock_obj = mock.MagicMock()
        mock_obj.pk = 456
        self.mock_queryset.get.return_value = mock_obj
        
        field = ModelChoiceField(queryset=self.mock_queryset)
        result = field.to_python(456)
        self.assertEqual(result, mock_obj)

    def test_to_python_invalid_pk(self):

from django.test import SimpleTestCase


class TestNumberFormat(SimpleTestCase):
    """Test suite for django.utils.numberformat.format function."""

    def setUp(self):
        """Set up test fixtures."""
        from django.utils.numberformat import format as num_format
        self.format = num_format

    # Test basic functionality with integers
    def test_format_integer_no_decimal(self):
        """Test formatting an integer without decimal positions."""
        result = self.format(123, ".")
        self.assertEqual(result, "123")

    def test_format_integer_with_decimal_pos_zero(self):
        """Test formatting an integer with decimal_pos=0."""
        result = self.format(123, ".", 0)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123")

    def test_format_integer_with_decimal_pos_two(self):
        """Test formatting an integer with decimal_pos=2."""
        result = self.format(123, ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.00")

    def test_format_negative_integer(self):
        """Test formatting a negative integer."""
        result = self.format(-123, ".")
        self.assertEqual(result, "-123")

    def test_format_negative_integer_with_decimals(self):
        """Test formatting a negative integer with decimals."""
        result = self.format(-123, ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "-123.00")

    # Test with float inputs
    def test_format_float_basic(self):
        """Test formatting a basic float."""
        result = self.format(123.456, ".")
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.456")

    def test_format_float_with_decimal_pos(self):
        """Test formatting a float with specific decimal positions."""
        result = self.format(123.456, ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.45")

    def test_format_float_truncates_decimals(self):
        """Test that floats are truncated to decimal_pos, not rounded."""
        result = self.format(123.459, ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.45")

    def test_format_float_negative(self):
        """Test formatting a negative float."""
        result = self.format(-123.456, ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "-123.45")

    # Test with Decimal inputs
    def test_format_decimal_basic(self):
        """Test formatting a Decimal object."""
        from decimal import Decimal
        result = self.format(Decimal("123.456"), ".")
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.456")

    def test_format_decimal_with_decimal_pos(self):
        """Test formatting a Decimal with specific decimal positions."""
        from decimal import Decimal
        result = self.format(Decimal("123.456"), ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.45")

    def test_format_decimal_small_cutoff(self):
        """Test that very small Decimals are cut off to zero."""
        from decimal import Decimal
        # Number smaller than cutoff for 2 decimal places
        result = self.format(Decimal("0.001"), ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "0.00")

    def test_format_decimal_large_value(self):
        """Test formatting a large Decimal value."""
        from decimal import Decimal
        result = self.format(Decimal("123456789.123456"), ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123456789.12")

    # Test with string inputs
    def test_format_string_number(self):
        """Test formatting a string number."""
        result = self.format("123.456", ".")
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.456")

    def test_format_string_number_with_decimal_pos(self):
        """Test formatting a string number with decimal positions."""
        result = self.format("123.456", ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.45")

    def test_format_string_integer(self):
        """Test formatting a string integer."""
        result = self.format("123", ".")
        self.assertEqual(result, "123")

    def test_format_string_negative(self):
        """Test formatting a negative string number."""
        result = self.format("-123.456", ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "-123.45")

    # Test with None and empty string
    def test_format_none_returns_marked_safe(self):
        """Test that None returns marked safe value."""
        result = self.format(None, ".")
        # mark_safe converts None to string "None"
        self.assertEqual(result, "None")

    def test_format_empty_string_returns_marked_safe(self):
        """Test that empty string returns marked safe value."""
        result = self.format("", ".")
        self.assertEqual(result, "")

    # Test thousand separator and grouping
    def test_format_with_thousand_separator(self):
        """Test formatting with thousand separator."""
        result = self.format(1234567, ",", 0, 3, ",", force_grouping=True)
        self.assertEqual(result, "1,234,567")

    def test_format_with_custom_decimal_sep(self):
        """Test formatting with custom decimal separator."""
        result = self.format(123.456, ",", 2)
        # Truncated to 2 decimal places and uses "," as decimal separator
        self.assertEqual(result, "123,45")

    def test_format_with_custom_thousand_sep(self):
        """Test formatting with custom thousand separator character."""
        result = self.format(1234567, ".", 0, 3, "'", force_grouping=True)
        self.assertEqual(result, "1'234'567")

    def test_format_non_uniform_grouping_sequence(self):
        """Test formatting with non-uniform grouping sequence."""
        result = self.format(123456789, ".", 0, (3, 2, 0), ",", force_grouping=True)
        self.assertEqual(result, "12,34,56,789")

    def test_format_grouping_with_decimals(self):
        """Test formatting with both grouping and decimals."""
        # Use different separators for thousand and decimal
        result = self.format(1234567.89, ".", 2, 3, ",", force_grouping=True)
        self.assertEqual(result, "1,234,567.89")

    # Test scientific notation handling
    def test_format_scientific_notation_float(self):
        """Test formatting a float in scientific notation."""
        result = self.format(1e10, ".", 0)
        self.assertIn("1", result)

    def test_format_scientific_notation_small(self):
        """Test formatting a small float in scientific notation."""
        result = self.format(1e-10, ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "0.00")

    # Test edge cases
    def test_format_zero(self):
        """Test formatting zero."""
        result = self.format(0, ".")
        self.assertEqual(result, "0")

    def test_format_zero_with_decimals(self):
        """Test formatting zero with decimal positions."""
        result = self.format(0, ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "0.00")

    def test_format_negative_zero(self):
        """Test formatting negative zero."""
        result = self.format(-0, ".")
        self.assertEqual(result, "0")

    def test_format_single_digit(self):
        """Test formatting a single digit."""
        result = self.format(5, ".")
        self.assertEqual(result, "5")

    def test_format_single_digit_with_decimals(self):
        """Test formatting a single digit with decimals."""
        result = self.format(5, ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "5.00")

    def test_format_no_grouping(self):
        """Test formatting without grouping."""
        result = self.format(1234567, ".", 0, 0, ",")
        self.assertEqual(result, "1234567")

    def test_format_force_grouping_false(self):
        """Test that force_grouping=False disables grouping."""
        result = self.format(1234567, ".", 0, 3, ",", force_grouping=False)
        self.assertEqual(result, "1234567")

    def test_format_decimal_part_shortened(self):
        """Test that decimal part is shortened to decimal_pos."""
        result = self.format("123.456789", ".", 3)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.456")

    def test_format_decimal_part_padded(self):
        """Test that decimal part is padded with zeros."""
        result = self.format("123.4", ".", 3)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.400")

    def test_format_no_decimal_point_input(self):
        """Test input without decimal point."""
        result = self.format("123", ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.00")

    def test_format_empty_decimal_part(self):
        """Test with trailing decimal point in input."""
        result = self.format("123.", ".", 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123.00")

    def test_format_large_integer_with_grouping(self):
        """Test large integer with grouping enabled."""
        result = self.format(123456789012345, ".", 0, 3, ",", force_grouping=True)
        self.assertEqual(result, "123,456,789,012,345")

    def test_format_all_parameters(self):
        """Test with all parameters specified."""
        # decimal_sep=",", thousand_sep="'" so result uses comma for decimals and ' for thousands
        result = self.format(
            1234567.891,
            ",",
            2,
            3,
            "'",
            True,
            None,
        )
        self.assertEqual(result, "1'234'567,89")

    # Test for very large Decimals (scientific notation path)
    def test_format_very_large_decimal_scientific_notation(self):
        """Test formatting a very large Decimal that triggers scientific notation."""
        from decimal import Decimal
        # Create a Decimal with more than 200 digits total (exponent + digit count)
        # This should trigger the scientific notation code path
        large_num = Decimal("1" + "0" * 200)  # 1e200 has exponent=200, digits=[1], sum=201 > 200
        result = self.format(large_num, ".", 0)
        # Should be formatted in scientific notation
        self.assertIn("e", result.lower())
        self.assertIn("1", result)

        rhs_value = Value('rhs', output_field=self.field)
        lookup = Lookup(lhs=self.value, rhs=rhs_value)
        exprs = lookup.get_source_expressions()
        self.assertEqual(len(exprs), 2)

    def test_set_source_expressions_one_expr(self):
        from django.db.models.lookups import Lookup
        lookup = Lookup(lhs=self.value, rhs='test')

        lookup.set_source_expressions(new_exprs)
        self.assertEqual(lookup.lhs, new_exprs[0])

        from django.db.models.lookups import Lookup
        lookup = Lookup(lhs=self.value, rhs='test')

    def test_separable_custom_calculate_method(self):
        """Test _separable when model has custom _calculate_separability_matrix."""
        from astropy.modeling.separable import _separable
        
        class CustomModel(Model):
            n_inputs = 1
            n_outputs = 1
            separable = True
            
            def evaluate(self, x, c0):
                return c0 * x
            
            def _calculate_separability_matrix(self):

        assert result.shape == (1, 1)

    def test_sys_path_directories_yields_parent_of_file(self):
        """Test sys_path_directories yields parent of file entries."""
        from django.utils.autoreload import sys_path_directories
        import tempfile
        
        # Temporarily add a file path (like a .egg or .whl)
        original_path = __import__('sys').path[:]
        try:
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.whl', delete=False) as f:
                temp_file = f.name
            
            try:
                __import__('sys').path.insert(0, temp_file)
                dirs = list(sys_path_directories())
                # Should yield parent directory
                found_parent = False
                for d in dirs:
                    if d == __import__('pathlib').Path(temp_file).parent:
                        found_parent = True
                        break
                self.assertTrue(found_parent)
            finally:
                __import__('os').unlink(temp_file)
        finally:
            __import__('sys').path[:] = original_path

import pytest

from sklearn.base import BaseEstimator, ClassifierMixin, RegressorMixin

class MockClassifier(BaseEstimator, ClassifierMixin):
    """A simple mock classifier for testing."""
    
    def __init__(self, predict_value=0):
        self.predict_value = predict_value
    
    def fit(self, X, y):
        self.classes_ = np.unique(y)
        return self
    
    def predict(self, X):
        return np.full(X.shape[0], self.predict_value)
    
    def predict_proba(self, X):
        n_classes = len(self.classes_)
        probas = np.zeros((X.shape[0], n_classes))
        if self.predict_value < n_classes:
            probas[:, self.predict_value] = 1.0
        return probas


class MockRegressor(BaseEstimator, RegressorMixin):

    def __init__(self, predict_value=0):
        self.predict_value = predict_value
    
    def fit(self, X, y):
        return self

        return np.full(X.shape[0], self.predict_value)

class TestVotingClassifierWeights:

    def test_weights_applied_hard_voting(self):

        from sklearn.ensemble import VotingClassifier
        from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
        
        # Create a simple case where weights matter
        X = np.array([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6], [7, 8]])

                                 ('dt2', DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42))],
                                voting='hard', weights=[2, 1])
        clf2.fit(X, y)
        
        # Both should produce valid predictions
        pred1 = clf1.predict(X)
        pred2 = clf2.predict(X)
        assert pred1.shape == (4,)
        assert pred2.shape == (4,)

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms import Form, IntegerField, CharField
from django.forms.formsets import (
    BaseFormSet,
    ManagementForm,
    all_valid,
    formset_factory,
)
from django.test import SimpleTestCase


class TestForm(Form):
    name = CharField()
    age = IntegerField(required=False)


class ManagementFormTests(SimpleTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        from django.forms.formsets import TOTAL_FORM_COUNT, INITIAL_FORM_COUNT
        self.TOTAL_FORM_COUNT = TOTAL_FORM_COUNT
        self.INITIAL_FORM_COUNT = INITIAL_FORM_COUNT

    def test_management_form_initial_values(self):
        """Test that ManagementForm has correct initial values."""
        from django.forms.formsets import MIN_NUM_FORM_COUNT, MAX_NUM_FORM_COUNT
        # ManagementForm needs proper field names in data for validation
        form = ManagementForm(data={
            "TOTAL_FORMS": "5",
            "INITIAL_FORMS": "3",
            "MIN_NUM_FORMS": "1",
            "MAX_NUM_FORMS": "10"
        })
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid())
        self.assertEqual(form.cleaned_data["TOTAL_FORMS"], 5)
        self.assertEqual(form.cleaned_data["INITIAL_FORMS"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(form.cleaned_data["MIN_NUM_FORMS"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(form.cleaned_data["MAX_NUM_FORMS"], 10)

    def test_management_form_missing_fields_default_to_zero(self):
        """Test that missing fields default to zero in cleaned_data."""
        form = ManagementForm(data={})
        form.full_clean()
        self.assertEqual(form.cleaned_data.get("TOTAL_FORMS", 0), 0)
        self.assertEqual(form.cleaned_data.get("INITIAL_FORMS", 0), 0)

    def test_management_form_invalid_integer(self):
        """Test that invalid integer values are handled."""
        form = ManagementForm(data={"TOTAL_FORMS": "invalid"})
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn("TOTAL_FORMS", form.errors)

"""Tests for the Point class in sympy.physics.vector."""
from sympy import symbols
from sympy.physics.vector.point import Point
from sympy.physics.vector.vector import Vector
from sympy.physics.vector.frame import ReferenceFrame
from sympy.physics.vector.functions import dynamicsymbols
from sympy.testing.pytest import raises


def test_point_init_basic():
    """Test basic Point initialization."""
    p = Point('P')
    assert p.name == 'P'
    assert p._pos_dict == {}
    assert p._vel_dict == {}
    assert p._acc_dict == {}
    assert len(p._pdlist) == 3


def test_point_init_multiple():
    """Test creating multiple Points."""
    p1 = Point('A')
    p2 = Point('B')
    p3 = Point('C')
    assert p1.name == 'A'
    assert p2.name == 'B'
    assert p3.name == 'C'


def test_point_str():
    """Test __str__ method."""
    p = Point('MyPoint')
    assert str(p) == 'MyPoint'


def test_point_repr():
    """Test __repr__ method."""
    p = Point('TestPoint')
    assert repr(p) == 'TestPoint'


def test_check_point_valid():
    """Test _check_point with valid Point."""
    p1 = Point('P1')
    p2 = Point('P2')
    # Should not raise
    p1._check_point(p2)


def test_check_point_invalid_type():
    """Test _check_point with invalid type raises TypeError."""
    p = Point('P')
    raises(TypeError, lambda: p._check_point("not a point"))


def test_check_point_none():
    """Test _check_point with None raises TypeError."""
    p = Point('P')
    raises(TypeError, lambda: p._check_point(None))


def test_locatenew_basic():
    """Test basic locatenew usage."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    P1 = Point('P1')
    P2 = P1.locatenew('P2', 10 * N.x)
    assert P2.name == 'P2'
    assert isinstance(P2, Point)


def test_locatenew_zero_vector():
    """Test locatenew with zero vector."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    P1 = Point('P1')
    P2 = P1.locatenew('P2', Vector(0))
    assert P2.name == 'P2'


def test_locatenew_invalid_name():
    """Test locatenew with invalid name raises TypeError."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    P1 = Point('P1')
    raises(TypeError, lambda: P1.locatenew(123, 10 * N.x))


def test_set_pos_basic():
    """Test basic set_pos usage."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p2 = Point('p2')
    p1.set_pos(p2, 10 * N.x)
    assert p2 in p1._pos_dict


def test_set_pos_mutual():
    """Test set_pos creates mutual position entries."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p2 = Point('p2')
    p1.set_pos(p2, 10 * N.x)
    assert p1._pos_dict[p2] == 10 * N.x
    assert p2._pos_dict[p1] == -10 * N.x


def test_set_pos_zero_vector():
    """Test set_pos with zero vector."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p2 = Point('p2')
    p1.set_pos(p2, Vector(0))
    assert p1._pos_dict[p2] == Vector(0)


def test_set_pos_invalid_otherpoint():
    """Test set_pos with invalid otherpoint raises TypeError."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    raises(TypeError, lambda: p1.set_pos("not a point", 10 * N.x))


def test_pos_from_basic():
    """Test basic pos_from usage."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p2 = Point('p2')
    p1.set_pos(p2, 10 * N.x)
    result = p1.pos_from(p2)
    assert result == 10 * N.x


def test_pos_from_chain():
    """Test pos_from with chain of points."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p2 = Point('p2')
    p3 = Point('p3')
    p1.set_pos(p2, 5 * N.x)
    p2.set_pos(p3, 3 * N.x)
    result = p1.pos_from(p3)
    assert result == 8 * N.x


def test_set_vel_basic():
    """Test basic set_vel usage."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p1.set_vel(N, 10 * N.x)
    assert N in p1._vel_dict


def test_set_vel_zero_vector():
    """Test set_vel with zero vector."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p1.set_vel(N, Vector(0))
    assert p1._vel_dict[N] == Vector(0)


def test_set_vel_multiple_frames():
    """Test set_vel in multiple frames."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    A = ReferenceFrame('A')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p1.set_vel(N, 10 * N.x)
    p1.set_vel(A, 5 * A.x)
    assert N in p1._vel_dict
    assert A in p1._vel_dict


def test_vel_defined():
    """Test vel when velocity is defined."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p1.set_vel(N, 10 * N.x)
    result = p1.vel(N)
    assert result == 10 * N.x


def test_vel_not_defined_raises():
    """Test vel raises ValueError when not defined."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    raises(ValueError, lambda: p1.vel(N))


def test_vel_from_relative_point():
    """Test vel calculated from relative point."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    q = dynamicsymbols('q')
    p = Point('p')
    p.set_vel(N, 10 * N.x)
    p2 = Point('p2')
    p2.set_pos(p, q*N.x)
    result = p2.vel(N)
    assert result is not None


def test_set_acc_basic():
    """Test basic set_acc usage."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p1.set_acc(N, 10 * N.x)
    assert N in p1._acc_dict


def test_set_acc_zero_vector():
    """Test set_acc with zero vector."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p1.set_acc(N, Vector(0))
    assert p1._acc_dict[N] == Vector(0)


def test_acc_defined():
    """Test acc when acceleration is defined."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p1.set_acc(N, 10 * N.x)
    result = p1.acc(N)
    assert result == 10 * N.x


def test_acc_from_velocity():
    """Test acc derived from velocity derivative."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    u1 = dynamicsymbols('u1')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p1.set_vel(N, u1 * N.x)
    result = p1.acc(N)
    assert result is not None


def test_acc_zero_when_no_velocity():
    """Test acc returns zero when velocity is zero."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p1.set_vel(N, Vector(0))
    result = p1.acc(N)
    assert result == Vector(0)


def test_v1pt_theory_basic():
    """Test basic v1pt_theory usage."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    B = ReferenceFrame('B')
    q = dynamicsymbols('q')
    qd = dynamicsymbols('q', 1)
    B.set_ang_vel(N, 5 * B.y)
    O = Point('O')
    P = O.locatenew('P', q * B.x)
    P.set_vel(B, qd * B.x)
    O.set_vel(N, 0)
    result = P.v1pt_theory(O, N, B)
    assert result is not None


def test_v2pt_theory_basic():
    """Test basic v2pt_theory usage."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    B = N.orientnew('B', 'Axis', [dynamicsymbols('q'), N.z])
    O = Point('O')
    P = O.locatenew('P', 10 * B.x)
    O.set_vel(N, 5 * N.x)
    result = P.v2pt_theory(O, N, B)
    assert result is not None


def test_a1pt_theory_basic():
    """Test basic a1pt_theory usage."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    B = ReferenceFrame('B')
    q = dynamicsymbols('q')
    qd = dynamicsymbols('q', 1)
    q2 = dynamicsymbols('q2')
    q2d = dynamicsymbols('q2', 1)
    B.set_ang_vel(N, 5 * B.y)
    O = Point('O')
    P = O.locatenew('P', q * B.x)
    P.set_vel(B, qd * B.x + q2d * B.y)
    O.set_vel(N, 0)
    result = P.a1pt_theory(O, N, B)
    assert result is not None


def test_a2pt_theory_basic():
    """Test basic a2pt_theory usage."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    B = N.orientnew('B', 'Axis', [dynamicsymbols('q'), N.z])
    O = Point('O')
    P = O.locatenew('P', 10 * B.x)
    O.set_vel(N, 5 * N.x)
    result = P.a2pt_theory(O, N, B)
    assert result is not None


def test_partial_velocity_single():
    """Test partial_velocity with single generalized speed."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    A = ReferenceFrame('A')
    p = Point('p')
    u1, u2 = dynamicsymbols('u1, u2')
    p.set_vel(N, u1 * N.x + u2 * A.y)
    result = p.partial_velocity(N, u1)
    assert result == N.x


def test_partial_velocity_multiple():
    """Test partial_velocity with multiple generalized speeds."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    A = ReferenceFrame('A')
    p = Point('p')
    u1, u2 = dynamicsymbols('u1, u2')
    p.set_vel(N, u1 * N.x + u2 * A.y)
    result = p.partial_velocity(N, u1, u2)
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
    assert len(result) == 2


def test_pdict_list_direct_connection():
    """Test _pdict_list with direct connection."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p2 = Point('p2')
    p1.set_pos(p2, 10 * N.x)
    result = p1._pdict_list(p2, 0)
    assert len(result) == 2
    assert result[0] == p1
    assert result[1] == p2


def test_pdict_list_no_path_raises():
    """Test _pdict_list raises ValueError when no path exists."""
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p2 = Point('p2')
    raises(ValueError, lambda: p1._pdict_list(p2, 0))


def test_point_empty_name():
    """Test Point with empty name."""
    p = Point('')
    assert p.name == ''
    assert str(p) == ''


def test_point_special_characters():
    """Test Point with special characters in name."""
    p = Point('Point_123!@#')
    assert p.name == 'Point_123!@#'


def test_multiple_points_same_frame():
    """Test multiple points with same frame."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p2 = Point('p2')
    p1.set_vel(N, 10 * N.x)
    p2.set_vel(N, 20 * N.x)
    assert p1.vel(N) == 10 * N.x
    assert p2.vel(N) == 20 * N.x


def test_point_chained_positions():
    """Test chained position relationships."""
    N = ReferenceFrame('N')
    p1 = Point('p1')
    p2 = Point('p2')
    p3 = Point('p3')
    p4 = Point('p4')
    p1.set_pos(p2, 1 * N.x)
    p2.set_pos(p3, 2 * N.x)
    p3.set_pos(p4, 3 * N.x)
    result = p1.pos_from(p4)
    assert result == 6 * N.x

def test_Routine_init():
    """Test Routine initialization with basic arguments."""
    expr = x + y
    result = Result(expr)
    arg_x = InputArgument(x)
    arg_y = InputArgument(y)
    
    routine = Routine("test", [arg_x, arg_y], [result], [], set())
    assert routine.name == "test"
    assert len(routine.arguments) == 2
    assert len(routine.results) == 1

class TestUnicodeComparison(SimpleTestCase):
    def test_equal_strings(self):
        """Test comparison of equal strings."""
        from django.contrib.auth.forms import _unicode_ci_compare
        result = _unicode_ci_compare('test', 'test')
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_case_insensitive(self):
        """Test case-insensitive comparison."""
        from django.contrib.auth.forms import _unicode_ci_compare
        result = _unicode_ci_compare('Test', 'TEST')
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_omega_and_ohm_signs(self):
        """Test Greek Omega and Ohm sign are equivalent."""
        from django.contrib.auth.forms import _unicode_ci_compare
        omega = 'iamtheΩ'  # U+03A9 GREEK CAPITAL LETTER OMEGA
        ohm = 'iamtheΩ'   # U+2126 OHM SIGN
        result = _unicode_ci_compare(omega, ohm)
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_different_strings(self):
        """Test different strings return False."""
        from django.contrib.auth.forms import _unicode_ci_compare
        result = _unicode_ci_compare('test', 'other')
        self.assertFalse(result)

"""Tests for sklearn.utils.validation module."""

import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse as sp
import pytest
import warnings


class TestAssertAllFinite:
    """Tests for assert_all_finite and _assert_all_finite functions."""

    def test_assert_all_finite_valid(self):
        """Test that valid finite arrays pass without error."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import assert_all_finite, _assert_all_finite
        
        X = np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
        assert_all_finite(X)
        _assert_all_finite(X)

    def test_assert_all_finite_nan_raises(self):
        """Test that NaN values raise ValueError."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import assert_all_finite, _assert_all_finite
        
        X = np.array([1.0, np.nan, 3.0])
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            assert_all_finite(X)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            _assert_all_finite(X)

    def test_assert_all_finite_inf_raises(self):
        """Test that infinity values raise ValueError."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import assert_all_finite, _assert_all_finite
        
        X = np.array([1.0, np.inf, 3.0])
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            assert_all_finite(X)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            _assert_all_finite(X)

    def test_assert_all_finite_allow_nan(self):
        """Test allow_nan parameter accepts NaN values."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import assert_all_finite, _assert_all_finite
        
        X = np.array([1.0, np.nan, 3.0])
        assert_all_finite(X, allow_nan=True)
        _assert_all_finite(X, allow_nan=True)

    def test_assert_all_finite_sparse_matrix(self):
        """Test assert_all_finite with sparse matrices."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import assert_all_finite
        
        X = sp.csr_matrix(np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]]))
        assert_all_finite(X)

    def test_assert_all_finite_sparse_with_nan(self):
        """Test assert_all_finite raises on sparse matrix with NaN."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import assert_all_finite
        
        data = np.array([1.0, np.nan, 3.0, 4.0])
        X = sp.csr_matrix((data, ([0, 0, 1, 1], [0, 1, 0, 1])), shape=(2, 2))
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            assert_all_finite(X)


class TestAsFloatArray:
    """Tests for as_float_array function."""

    def test_as_float_array_basic(self):
        """Test basic conversion to float array."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import as_float_array
        
        X = np.array([1, 2, 3])
        result = as_float_array(X)
        assert result.dtype in [np.float32, np.float64]

    def test_as_float_array_copy_true(self):
        """Test copy=True creates a copy."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import as_float_array
        
        X = np.array([1, 2, 3])
        result = as_float_array(X, copy=True)
        assert not np.shares_memory(X, result)

    def test_as_float_array_copy_false(self):
        """Test copy=False may return same memory."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import as_float_array
        
        X = np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
        result = as_float_array(X, copy=False)
        # May or may not share memory depending on dtype

    def test_as_float_array_force_all_finite(self):
        """Test force_all_finite=True rejects inf/nan."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import as_float_array
        
        # Test with non-float dtype that needs conversion
        X = np.array([1, np.nan, 3], dtype=object)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            as_float_array(X, force_all_finite=True)

    def test_as_float_array_allow_nan(self):
        """Test force_all_finite='allow-nan' accepts nan."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import as_float_array
        
        X = np.array([1.0, np.nan, 3.0])
        result = as_float_array(X, force_all_finite='allow-nan')
        assert result is not None

    def test_as_float_array_sparse(self):
        """Test as_float_array with sparse matrix."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import as_float_array
        
        X = sp.csr_matrix(np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]]))
        result = as_float_array(X)
        assert result is not None

    def test_as_float_array_int8(self):
        """Test as_float_array with int8 dtype."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import as_float_array
        
        X = np.array([1, 2, 3], dtype=np.int8)
        result = as_float_array(X)
        assert result.dtype == np.float32

    def test_as_float_array_int64(self):
        """Test as_float_array with int64 dtype."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import as_float_array
        
        X = np.array([1, 2, 3], dtype=np.int64)
        result = as_float_array(X)
        assert result.dtype == np.float64


class TestIsArraylike:
    """Tests for _is_arraylike function."""

    def test_is_arraylike_list(self):
        """Test list is considered array-like."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _is_arraylike
        
        assert _is_arraylike([1, 2, 3]) is True

    def test_is_arraylike_numpy_array(self):
        """Test numpy array is considered array-like."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _is_arraylike
        
        assert _is_arraylike(np.array([1, 2, 3])) is True

    def test_is_arraylike_tuple(self):
        """Test tuple is considered array-like."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _is_arraylike
        
        assert _is_arraylike((1, 2, 3)) is True

    def test_is_arraylike_scalar(self):
        """Test scalar is not considered array-like."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _is_arraylike
        
        assert _is_arraylike(5) is False


class TestNumSamples:
    """Tests for _num_samples function."""

    def test_num_samples_list(self):
        """Test _num_samples with list."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _num_samples
        
        assert _num_samples([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) == 5

    def test_num_samples_numpy_array(self):
        """Test _num_samples with numpy array."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _num_samples
        
        X = np.array([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]])
        assert _num_samples(X) == 3

    def test_num_samples_estimator_raises(self):
        """Test _num_samples raises for estimator objects."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _num_samples
        
        class MockEstimator:
            def fit(self):
                pass
        
        mock = MockEstimator()
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            _num_samples(mock)

    def test_num_samples_singleton_raises(self):
        """Test _num_samples raises for singleton array."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _num_samples
        
        X = np.array(5)
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            _num_samples(X)

    def test_num_samples_1d_array(self):
        """Test _num_samples with 1D array."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _num_samples
        
        X = np.array([1, 2, 3])
        assert _num_samples(X) == 3


class TestShapeRepr:
    """Tests for _shape_repr function."""

    def test_shape_repr_empty(self):
        """Test empty shape representation."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _shape_repr
        
        assert _shape_repr(()) == "()"

    def test_shape_repr_single(self):
        """Test single element shape."""
        from sklearn.utils.validation import _shape_repr

from django.test import SimpleTestCase

class BaseSerializerTests(SimpleTestCase):
    """Tests for BaseSerializer class."""

    def setUp(self):
        from django.db.migrations.serializer import BaseSerializer
        self.BaseSerializer = BaseSerializer

    def test_base_serializer_init(self):
        """Test BaseSerializer initialization."""
        from django.db.migrations.serializer import BaseSerializer
        value = "test_value"
        serializer = BaseSerializer(value)
        self.assertEqual(serializer.value, value)

    def test_base_serializer_serialize_not_implemented(self):
        """Test that BaseSerializer.serialize raises NotImplementedError."""
        from django.db.migrations.serializer import BaseSerializer
        serializer = BaseSerializer("test")
        with self.assertRaises(NotImplementedError) as context:
            serializer.serialize()
        self.assertIn("Subclasses of BaseSerializer must implement", str(context.exception))

    AiryAi, AiryAiPrime, AiryBi, AiryBiPrime, ExpIntegralEi, SinIntegral,
    CosIntegral, LogIntegral, PrimePi, Prime, PrimeQ, Pochhammer, ArcTan,
    Set, SetDelayed, AddTo, SubtractFrom, TimesBy, DivideBy, Decrement, Part,
    List, Defer, Identity, Number, Rational, Integer, Float, Complex, factorial,
)
from sympy.functions.combinatorial.factorials import factorial as fact_func, factorial2


class TestParseMathematicaBasic:
    """Test basic parsing functionality."""

    def test_parse_simple_expression(self):
        """Test parsing simple expressions."""
        from sympy.parsing.mathematica import parse_mathematica
        result = parse_mathematica("x + y")
        assert result == x + y

    def test_parse_multiplication(self):
        """Test parsing multiplication."""
        from sympy.parsing.mathematica import parse_mathematica
        result = parse_mathematica("x*y")
        assert result == x * y

    def test_parse_power(self):
        """Test parsing power expressions."""
        from sympy.parsing.mathematica import parse_mathematica
        result = parse_mathematica("x^2")
        assert result == x ** 2

    def test_parse_function_call(self):
        """Test parsing function calls."""
        from sympy.parsing.mathematica import parse_mathematica
        result = parse_mathematica("Sin[x]")
        assert result == sin(x)

    def test_parse_multiple_functions(self):
        """Test parsing multiple functions."""
        from sympy.parsing.mathematica import parse_mathematica
        result = parse_mathematica("Sin[x]^2 Tan[y]")
        assert result == sin(x)**2 * tan(y)

    def test_parse_fullform_times(self):
        """Test parsing FullForm Times."""
        from sympy.parsing.mathematica import parse_mathematica
        result = parse_mathematica("Times[x, Plus[a, b]]")
        assert result == x * (a + b)

    def test_parse_matrix(self):
        """Test parsing matrix expressions."""
        from sympy.parsing.mathematica import parse_mathematica
        result = parse_mathematica("[[a, b], [c, d]]")
        assert isinstance(result, tuple)

    def test_parse_pi_constant(self):
        """Test parsing Pi constant."""
        from sympy.parsing.mathematica import parse_mathematica
        result = parse_mathematica("Pi")
        assert result == pi

    def test_parse_complex_number(self):
        """Test parsing complex number I."""
        from sympy.parsing.mathematica import parse_mathematica
        result = parse_mathematica("I")
        assert result == I

from sympy.core.numbers import Rational

from sympy.physics.units.dimensions import Dimension
from sympy.physics.units.quantities import Quantity


def test_init_basic():
    """Test basic initialization of UnitSystem."""
    from sympy.physics.units.unitsystem import UnitSystem
    from sympy.physics.units.definitions import m, s
    
    ms = UnitSystem((m, s), name="MS", descr="MS system")
    assert ms.name == "MS"
    assert ms.descr == "MS system"
    assert set(ms._base_units) == {m, s}


def test_init_with_units():
    """Test initialization with additional units."""
    from sympy.physics.units.unitsystem import UnitSystem
    from sympy.physics.units.definitions import m, s, c
    
    ms = UnitSystem((m, s), (c,), name="MS")
    assert set(ms._units) == {m, s, c}


def test_init_with_derived_units():
    """Test initialization with derived units."""
    from sympy.physics.units.unitsystem import UnitSystem
    from sympy.physics.units.definitions import m, s
    from sympy.physics.units.definitions.dimension_definitions import velocity
    
    v = Quantity("velocity_unit")
    ms = UnitSystem((m, s), derived_units={velocity: v})
    assert ms.derived_units[velocity] == v

    """Test __str__ when name is set."""

    ms = UnitSystem((m, s))

"""
Test suite for django.core.management.base module.

import os
import sys

from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

from django.test import SimpleTestCase


class CommandErrorTests(SimpleTestCase):
    """Tests for CommandError exception class."""

    def test_command_error_default_returncode(self):
        """CommandError should have default returncode of 1."""
        from django.core.management.base import CommandError
        err = CommandError("test message")
        self.assertEqual(err.returncode, 1)

    def test_command_error_custom_returncode(self):
        """CommandError should accept custom returncode."""
        from django.core.management.base import CommandError
        err = CommandError("test message", returncode=2)
        self.assertEqual(err.returncode, 2)

    def test_command_error_args(self):
        """CommandError should store args."""
        from django.core.management.base import CommandError
        err = CommandError("arg1", "arg2")
        self.assertIn("arg1", str(err))


class SystemCheckErrorTests(SimpleTestCase):
    """Tests for SystemCheckError exception class."""

    def test_system_check_error_is_command_error(self):
        """SystemCheckError should be a subclass of CommandError."""
        from django.core.management.base import SystemCheckError, CommandError
        self.assertTrue(issubclass(SystemCheckError, CommandError))


class CommandParserTests(SimpleTestCase):
    """Tests for CommandParser class."""

    def test_parser_init_with_missing_args_message(self):
        """Parser should accept missing_args_message parameter."""
        from django.core.management.base import CommandParser
        parser = CommandParser(missing_args_message="Missing args!")
        self.assertEqual(parser.missing_args_message, "Missing args!")

    def test_parser_init_with_called_from_command_line(self):
        """Parser should accept called_from_command_line parameter."""
        from django.core.management.base import CommandParser
        parser = CommandParser(called_from_command_line=True)
        self.assertTrue(parser.called_from_command_line)

    def test_parser_error_when_not_from_command_line(self):
        """error() should raise CommandError when not from command line."""
        from django.core.management.base import CommandParser, CommandError
        parser = CommandParser(called_from_command_line=False)
        with self.assertRaises(CommandError) as cm:
            parser.error("test error message")
        self.assertIn("Error:", str(cm.exception))

    def test_parser_error_when_from_command_line(self):
        """error() should call super().error when from command line."""
        from django.core.management.base import CommandParser
        parser = CommandParser(called_from_command_line=True)
        # When called_from_command_line is True, it calls super().error
        # which raises SystemExit - we'll just verify the attribute is set
        self.assertTrue(parser.called_from_command_line)


class HandleDefaultOptionsTests(SimpleTestCase):

        options = MagicMock()
        options.settings = "myproject.settings"
        options.pythonpath = None
        
        with patch.dict('os.environ', {}, clear=True):
            handle_default_options(options)
            self.assertEqual(os.environ.get("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE"), "myproject.settings")

    def test_handle_default_options_sets_pythonpath(self):
        """handle_default_options should add pythonpath to sys.path."""
        from django.core.management.base import handle_default_options
        options = MagicMock()

        options.pythonpath = "/custom/path"
        
        original_path = list(sys.path)

    """Test initialization of NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis."""

    def test_default_init(self):

        from sklearn.neighbors.nca import NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis
        nca = NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis()
        assert nca.init == 'auto'
        assert nca.n_components is None
        assert nca.warm_start is False
        assert nca.max_iter == 50
        assert nca.tol == 1e-5
        assert nca.verbose == 0
        assert nca.random_state is None

class TestInterceptDot:
    """Tests for _intercept_dot function."""

    def test_no_intercept(self):
        """Test _intercept_dot without intercept."""
        X = np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]])
        y = np.array([1.0, -1.0])
        w = np.array([0.5, 0.3])
        
        w_out, c, yz = _intercept_dot(w, X, y)
        assert_array_equal(w_out, w)
        assert_equal(c, 0.)
        expected_yz = y * (X @ w)
        assert_allclose(yz, expected_yz)

    def test_with_intercept(self):
        """Test _intercept_dot with intercept."""
        X = np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]])
        y = np.array([1.0, -1.0])
        w = np.array([0.5, 0.3, 0.1])
        
        w_out, c, yz = _intercept_dot(w, X, y)
        assert_equal(len(w_out), 2)
        assert_almost_equal(c, 0.1)
        expected_yz = y * (X @ w[:2] + c)
        assert_allclose(yz, expected_yz)

class EdgeCasesTests(SimpleTestCase):
    def test_resolvermatch_with_partial_func(self):
        from functools import partial
        from .views import empty_view
        
        partial_view = partial(empty_view, template_name='test.html')
        match = ResolverMatch(
            func=partial_view,
            args=(),
            kwargs={},
            url_name=None,
            app_names=[],
            namespaces=[],
            route='/test/',
            tried=[]
        )
        self.assertIn('partial', repr(match))

    def test_resolvermatch_empty_app_names(self):
        match = ResolverMatch(
            func=lambda r: None,
            args=(),
            kwargs={},
            url_name=None,
            app_names=[None, '', 'valid'],
            namespaces=[None, '', 'valid-ns'],
            route='/test/',
            tried=[]
        )
        self.assertEqual(match.app_names, ['valid'])
        self.assertEqual(match.app_name, 'valid')
        self.assertEqual(match.namespaces, ['valid-ns'])
        self.assertEqual(match.namespace, 'valid-ns')

    def test_regexpattern_match_with_none_groups(self):
        pattern = RegexPattern(r'^(?:test)?(?P<pk>[0-9]+)/$')
        result = pattern.match('/123/')
        self.assertIsNotNone(result)
        self.assertEqual(result[2]['pk'], '123')

    def test_urlresolver_default_kwargs_merge(self):
        from .views import empty_view
        resolver = URLResolver(
            RegexPattern(r'^'),
            [URLPattern(
                RegexPattern(r'^test/(?P<pk>[0-9]+)/$'),
                empty_view,
                default_args={'default_key': 'default_value'}
            )]
        )
        result = resolver.resolve('/test/123/')
        self.assertIsNotNone(result)
        self.assertIn('default_key', result.kwargs)
        self.assertEqual(result.kwargs['default_key'], 'default_value')

    def test_urlresolver_nested_resolution(self):
        from .views import empty_view
        
        inner_resolver = URLResolver(
            RegexPattern(r'^inner/'),
            [URLPattern(RegexPattern(r'^test/$'), empty_view, name='inner-test')]
        )
        
        outer_resolver = URLResolver(
            RegexPattern(r'^outer/'),
            [URLPattern(RegexPattern(r''), include(inner_resolver))]
        )
        
        # This tests nested resolution capability
        self.assertIsInstance(inner_resolver, URLResolver)

        from .views import empty_view

        )

        """Test with empty context."""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pytest
from pandas.testing import assert_frame_equal

from seaborn._stats.regression import PolyFit


class RegressionFixtures:

    @pytest.fixture
    def df(self, rng):
        n = 100
        return pd.DataFrame(dict(
            x=rng.uniform(0, 10, n),
            y=rng.normal(size=n) * 2 + rng.uniform(0, 10, n) * 0.5,
            group=rng.choice(["a", "b"], n),
        ))

    def get_groupby(self, df, orient):
        # For regression, we group by categorical variables only (not x or y)
        cols = [c for c in df if c not in ["x", "y"]]
        from seaborn._core.groupby import GroupBy
        return GroupBy(cols)


class TestPolyFit(RegressionFixtures):

    def test_default_order(self, df):
        """Test PolyFit with default order=2."""
        from seaborn._stats.regression import PolyFit
        ori = "x"
        gb = self.get_groupby(df, ori)
        pf = PolyFit()
        res = pf(df, gb, ori, {})
        assert isinstance(res, pd.DataFrame)
        assert "x" in res.columns
        assert "y" in res.columns
        # With grouping by 'group', we should have gridsize rows per group
        expected_len = pf.gridsize * df["group"].nunique()
        assert len(res) == expected_len

    def test_custom_order(self, df):
        """Test PolyFit with custom order."""
        from seaborn._stats.regression import PolyFit
        ori = "x"
        gb = self.get_groupby(df, ori)
        pf = PolyFit(order=3)
        res = pf(df, gb, ori, {})
        assert isinstance(res, pd.DataFrame)
        assert "x" in res.columns
        assert "y" in res.columns
        expected_len = pf.gridsize * df["group"].nunique()
        assert len(res) == expected_len

    def test_custom_gridsize(self, df):
        """Test PolyFit with custom gridsize."""
        from seaborn._stats.regression import PolyFit
        ori = "x"
        gb = self.get_groupby(df, ori)
        pf = PolyFit(gridsize=50)
        res = pf(df, gb, ori, {})
        assert isinstance(res, pd.DataFrame)
        expected_len = 50 * df["group"].nunique()
        assert len(res) == expected_len

    def test_fit_predict_basic(self, df):
        """Test _fit_predict method directly."""
        from seaborn._stats.regression import PolyFit
        pf = PolyFit(order=2)
        data = df[["x", "y"]].head(20)
        result = pf._fit_predict(data)
        assert isinstance(result, pd.DataFrame)
        assert "x" in result.columns
        assert "y" in result.columns

    def test_fit_predict_few_unique_x(self, df):

class SafeExceptionReporterFilterTests(SimpleTestCase):
    """Tests for SafeExceptionReporterFilter class."""

    def setUp(self):
        from django.views.debug import SafeExceptionReporterFilter
        self.filter_class = SafeExceptionReporterFilter
        self.filter = self.filter_class()

    def test_cleansed_substitute_constant(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.filter.cleansed_substitute, '********************')

    def test_hidden_settings_pattern_matches_api(self):
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('API_KEY', 'secret123')
        self.assertEqual(result, '********************')

    def test_hidden_settings_pattern_matches_token(self):
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('TOKEN', 'secret123')
        self.assertEqual(result, '********************')

    def test_hidden_settings_pattern_matches_key(self):
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('MY_API_KEY', 'secret123')
        self.assertEqual(result, '********************')

    def test_hidden_settings_pattern_matches_secret(self):
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('SECRET_KEY', 'secret123')
        self.assertEqual(result, '********************')

    def test_hidden_settings_pattern_matches_pass(self):
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('PASSWORD', 'secret123')
        self.assertEqual(result, '********************')

    def test_hidden_settings_pattern_matches_signature(self):
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('SIGNATURE', 'secret123')
        self.assertEqual(result, '********************')

    def test_cleanse_setting_non_sensitive_returns_value(self):
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('DEBUG', True)
        self.assertEqual(result, True)

    def test_cleanse_setting_dict_recursively_cleanses(self):
        value = {
            'API_KEY': 'secret',
            'NORMAL_SETTING': 'normal'  # Doesn't contain sensitive keywords
        }
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('DATABASES', value)
        self.assertEqual(result['API_KEY'], '********************')
        self.assertEqual(result['NORMAL_SETTING'], 'normal')

    def test_cleanse_setting_list_cleanses_items(self):
        # When processing list items, empty string '' is used as key
        # Since '' doesn't match the pattern, items are not cleansed
        value = ['value1', 'value2']
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('LIST_SETTING', value)
        self.assertEqual(result[0], 'value1')
        self.assertEqual(result[1], 'value2')

    def test_cleanse_setting_tuple_cleanses_items(self):
        # When processing tuple items, empty string '' is used as key
        # Since '' doesn't match the pattern, items are not cleansed
        value = ('value1', 'value2')
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('TUPLE_SETTING', value)
        self.assertEqual(result[0], 'value1')
        self.assertEqual(result[1], 'value2')

    def test_cleanse_setting_type_error_returns_value(self):
        # When key isn't regex-able
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting(None, 'value')
        self.assertEqual(result, 'value')

    def test_cleanse_setting_callable_wraps_result(self):
        def dummy_callable():
            pass
        
        result = self.filter.cleanse_setting('CALLABLE_SETTING', dummy_callable)
        from django.views.debug import CallableSettingWrapper
        self.assertIsInstance(result, CallableSettingWrapper)

    @patch('django.views.debug.settings')
    def test_get_safe_settings_filters_sensitive_keys(self, mock_settings):
        mock_settings.DEBUG = True
        mock_settings.SECRET_KEY = 'my-secret-key'
        mock_settings.NORMAL_SETTING = 'normal'
        
        with patch.object(mock_settings, '__iter__', return_value=['DEBUG', 'SECRET_KEY', 'NORMAL_SETTING']):
            result = self.filter.get_safe_settings()
            self.assertIn('SECRET_KEY', result)
            self.assertEqual(result['SECRET_KEY'], '********************')

    def test_is_active_returns_false_when_debug_true(self):
